title: The Kerala Official Languages Act, 1969 (No.7 of 1969)
full_text: The Kerala Official Languages Act, 1969 (No.7 of 1969) Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act Number: 7 Enactment Date: 1969-02-19 Act Year: 1969 Short Title: The Kerala Official Languages Act, 1969 (No.7 of 1969) Department: Department of Law Type: STATE Location: Kerala TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles The Kerala Official Languages Act, 1969 (No.7 of 1969) Show all section Section 1. Short title and commencement. Section 1A. Malayalam and English to be the official languages of the State. Section 1B. Government's power to notify the official purposes for which Malayalam or English to be used. Section 1C. Notification issued under section 1 B to be placed before the Legislative Assembly. Section 2. Language to be used in Bills, etc. Section 3. Special provisions in respect of linguistic minorities.
